not_verified: No mates or motion: wheels do not spin, cranks do not turn; all instances are fixed

one_line: A diamond-frame road bicycle at real 700c proportions: one frame part carrying the full tube set, fork, cockpit, saddle and drivetrain, with two spoked wheels and a chain drive on a y=+47 mm chainline.
poses: hero: isometric view from front-left, bicycle static on its wheels with the kickstand down
detail: close-up of the bottom bracket, chainring, chain runs, rear cog and dropout plates

Frame points: bottom bracket (-70, 288), seat cluster (-212, 712), head tube (415, 725) to (443, 652); main tubes r=15-16 mm, stays r=6-7 mm
Wheels: tyre torus (centre circle r=307, tube r=15), rim torus (r=285, tube r=6), hub barrel r=16 with r=6.5 axle bore, 12 spokes r=1.1 per wheel
Drivetrain: chainring r=84 and rear cog r=24 on a y=+47 mm chainline, two straight chain runs r=3.5, cranks angled out to pedals at y=+/-74
